architecture, security/privacy, data/domain, AI and UX applicability

migration, rollback or forward-repair and observability expectations

attributed authoritative GitHub Issue before execution

test/evaluation expectations map to every acceptance criterion and reverse traceability covers material code, tests, Issues, defects, and PRs.

observability, agent attribution, notifications, CI, and the absence of unresolved material human decisions are verified truthfully.
